statement: theorem finite_regret_identity {E : Type*} (psi loss : ℕ → E → ℝ) (x : ℕ → E) (u z : E) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) : let y : ℕ → E := fun t => if t = T then z else x t let G : ℕ → E → ℝ := fun t v => psi t v + ∑ i ∈ range (t + 1), loss i v (∑ t ∈ range T, (loss t (y t) - loss t u)) = psi (T - 1) u - psi 0 (y 0) + (∑ t ∈ range T, (G t (y t) - G t (y (t + 1)))) + (∑ t ∈ range (T - 1), (psi t (y (t + 1)) - psi (t + 1) (y (t + 1)))) + G (T - 1) z - G (T - 1) u
